rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for cattle or a farm cow in general.

example.english: There’s a cow on the farm.

rows.note: Use this specifically when “cow” means beef as food.

example.english: We’re having cow for dinner tonight.

rows.note: Use this colloquial term for an adult female cow in everyday speech.

example.english: That cow just had a calf.
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 ngau4 naa2 ngaam1 ngaam1 saang1 zo2 zai2

rows.note: Use this more formal or written term for an adult female cow rather than the colloquial 牛乸.
